scope: Partial seed: five public-source, documentation-only research candidates for issue #33, not a completeness, adoption or deployment claim.
method: Read pinned public upstream README, root LICENSE and directory listings, supplemented by the pinned A2A specification file and OpenClaw THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and SECURITY policy. GitHub license metadata is supplementary. No upstream code, packages, services, binaries, private data or dependencies were imported or executed. An additional source-only check records pinned package-license declarations where directly observed; component, distribution, dependency, security and resource clearance remain unresolved.
decision_policy: Only a separately evidenced and dated owner/maintainer decision can change PENDING to ADOPTED or REJECTED. A review trigger initiates reevaluation only.
